name: iPhone 7 Global / D10 / iOS 16.1 20B82
ramdisk_boot_args: rd=md0 debug=0x2014e cs_enforcement_disable=1 panic-wait-forever=1 -v keepsyms=1 panic=0 wdt=-1
system_boot_args: rd=disk1s8 debug=0x2014e cs_enforcement_disable=1 panic-wait-forever=1 -v keepsyms=1 panic=0 wdt=-1
known_limitations: Highly experimental and for personal research only. Requires DFU, SSHRD, APFS and recovery experience; unsuitable for inexperienced users or daily use.
Do not store sensitive personal information or important data on this device.
Data loss, hangs, boot failure and a full restore may occur.
Only iPhone9,1 / D10AP Global is accepted. GSM and other variants have not been tested and are not supported by this workflow.
A computer-assisted DFU boot is required after every restart or power loss.
SEP support is partial. Never configure a device passcode, including during Setup Assistant; passcode operations may hang or restart the device.
Touch ID enrollment does not establish reliable unlocking or local authentication. Adding VPN configurations is currently affected by an ACM/SEP failure.
The pressure-sensitive physical Home button is not working. Use AssistiveTouch.
Baseband is unresearched: the author's cellular/SIM hardware is faulty, iPhone7 has two baseband hardware variants, and no GSM device was available for testing.
Camera video recording and AVE encoding are not working. Use Most Compatible format for still photos; High Efficiency capture and panorama remain unresolved.
Microphone and Voice Memos recording work, but Siri and dictation remain problematic.
Standby power management remains unresolved; severe overnight battery drain has been observed.
The current patch set disables healthd and mobiletimerd; Health, alarms, timers and Sleep-related functionality are not validated.
The Data volume is shared. Booting stock iOS15 after iOS16 migration may damage compatibility; return to stock through a fresh restore.
